# ShopCardHub

> Price indices for Pokémon TCG sets and 1st Bowman Chrome autos. Each index is the cost of one copy of every card in a set, set to 100 at a base month and re-marked on sold prices. Last mark: Nov 12, 2026.

Every index level is a dated read of completed sales. Where a page shows a listing price it is labelled an ask. Pages track prices; they do not tell anyone to buy or sell.

## Start here
- [Home: the index board](https://www.shopcardhub.com)
- [All indices, ranked by 1-week, 1-month and 3-month move](https://www.shopcardhub.com/indices)
- [How the indices are priced](https://www.shopcardhub.com/how-prices-work)
- [Release calendar](https://www.shopcardhub.com/release-calendar)

## Questions answered here
- [Is the Pokémon card market up or down?](https://www.shopcardhub.com/indices): In the latest month of marks, newer Pokémon sets were down and vintage WOTC sets were mostly down. All eight Pokémon sets released in 2025 and 2026 fell, by 9.3% to 24.0%. Of the ten Unlimited WOTC sets from 1999 to 2003, three rose and seven fell, from −10.9% to +6.5%. All three 2026 1st Bowman Chrome Auto indices fell, by 12.7% to 13.7%. Each move compares an index's latest mark (Nov 9 or Nov 12, 2026) with its mark 27 to 41 days before. Levels come from dated sold prices and start at 100 in a base month.
- [Is the Pokémon card market crashing?](https://www.shopcardhub.com/indices): At marks from Nov 9 to Nov 12, 2026, all eight Pokémon sets released in 2025 and 2026 stood below 100, at 33.13 to 62.36, which puts each 37.6% to 66.9% under its base month (Jan 2025 to Sep 2026). All ten Unlimited WOTC sets from 1999 to 2003 stood above 100, at 113.08 to 384.87, against base months from Jan 2021 to Jan 2022. 100 is each index's level in its own base month, and every level comes from dated sold prices.
- [What is a Base Set Charizard worth (1st Edition, Shadowless, Unlimited)?](https://www.shopcardhub.com/pokemon-base-set-index): On Nov 12, 2026, a raw Base Set Charizard #4 sold for a median of $6,986 in 1st Edition, $1,027 in Shadowless, and $320 in Unlimited. Each figure is the median of that printing's ungraded sales over the last 90 days. A 1st Edition copy sold for about 22 times an Unlimited one. To tell them apart: 1st Edition has the black 1st Edition stamp just under the picture on the left. Shadowless has no stamp and no drop shadow along the right edge of the picture frame. Unlimited has that shadow and no stamp.
- [What are Pokémon Base Set (Unlimited) cards selling for?](https://www.shopcardhub.com/pokemon-base-set-index): The BS99 index stood at 113.08 on Nov 12, 2026 (100 = Jan 2021), across 101 cards on dated sold prices; one copy of each card came to about $983. Over the latest month it moved −10.8% (from Oct 15, 2026).
- [What are Pokémon Base Set 1st Edition cards selling for?](https://www.shopcardhub.com/pokemon-base-set-1st-edition-index): The BS1E index stood at 216.42 on Nov 12, 2026 (100 = Jan 2021), across 102 cards on dated sold prices; one copy of each card came to about $18,303. Over the latest month it moved −24.0% (from Oct 15, 2026).
- [What are Pokémon 151 (Scarlet & Violet 151) cards selling for?](https://www.shopcardhub.com/scarlet-violet-151-index): The SV151 index stood at 151.44 on Nov 12, 2026 (100 = Sep 2023), across 207 cards on dated sold prices; one copy of each card came to about $1,636. Over the latest month it moved −7.2% (from Oct 15, 2026).
- [Are 2026 1st Bowman Chrome Auto prices going up or down?](https://www.shopcardhub.com/bowman-1st-chrome-index): The BOW26 index stood at 57.13 on Nov 12, 2026 (100 = May 2026), across 162 cards on dated sold prices; one copy of each card came to about $2,287. Over the latest month it moved −12.7% (from Oct 15, 2026).
- [What is a 1st Bowman card, and is it a rookie card?](https://www.shopcardhub.com/what-is-a-1st-bowman-card): A 1st Bowman is a prospect's first Bowman card, marked in most years by a 1st logo; a prospect gets at most one 1st Bowman Chrome and at most one 1st Bowman Chrome Auto, and neither is a rookie card (the RC logo needs an MLB active roster). The BOW26 index stood at 57.13 on Nov 12, 2026 (100 = May 2026), across 162 cards on dated sold prices; one copy of each card came to about $2,287. Over the latest month it moved −12.7% (from Oct 15, 2026).
- [Are Prismatic Evolutions chase card prices going up or down?](https://www.shopcardhub.com/prismatic-evolutions-index): The PRIS25 index stood at 61.10 on Nov 9, 2026 (100 = Jan 2025), across 49 cards on dated sold prices; one copy of each card came to about $3,604. Over the latest month it moved −9.3% (from Oct 12, 2026).
- [Are Ascended Heroes chase card prices going up or down?](https://www.shopcardhub.com/ascended-heroes-index): The AH26 index stood at 58.70 on Nov 9, 2026 (100 = Feb 2026), across 70 cards on dated sold prices; one copy of each card came to about $3,468. Over the latest month it moved −21.6% (from Oct 12, 2026).
- [What are Evolving Skies cards selling for, Umbreon VMAX #215 included?](https://www.shopcardhub.com/evolving-skies-index): The EVS21 index stood at 263.70 on Nov 12, 2026 (100 = Sep 2021), across 237 cards on dated sold prices; one copy of each card came to about $6,736. Over the latest month it moved +0.1% (from Oct 15, 2026).
- [Are 2026 Bowman Chrome (September) 1st Bowman Chrome Auto prices going up or down?](https://www.shopcardhub.com/bowman-chrome-2026-index): The BCB26 index stood at 58.41 on Nov 12, 2026 (100 = Sep 2026), across 95 cards on dated sold prices; one copy of each card came to about $1,160. Over the latest month it moved −13.7% (from Oct 15, 2026).
- [What are Pokémon Base Set Shadowless cards selling for?](https://www.shopcardhub.com/pokemon-base-set-shadowless-index): The BSSL index stood at 128.26 on Nov 12, 2026 (100 = Jan 2021), across 101 cards on dated sold prices; one copy of each card came to about $2,687. Over the latest month it moved +1.1% (from Oct 15, 2026).
- [What are Pokémon Neo Genesis 1st Edition cards selling for, Lugia #9 included?](https://www.shopcardhub.com/neo-genesis-1st-edition-index): The NG1E index stood at 207.46 on Nov 12, 2026 (100 = Sep 2021), across 111 cards on dated sold prices; one copy of each card came to about $5,162. Over the latest month it moved +3.6% (from Oct 15, 2026).
